policy.audrok_positive: publisher recording label inherited to crop; weak audibility
policy.channel: physical channel0, no beamforming or array means
policy.crop: FSD/AuDroK one central min(3s,native length); WSU all supported disjoint3s windows
policy.eligibility: finite nonzero crop >=0.25s; decoded identity duplicates quarantined
policy.fsd_negative: non-aircraft human foreground labels, metadata UAV exclusion; weak absence evidence
policy.inference: crop classification, not a continuous alarm experiment
policy.normalization: none external to the pinned BEATs frontend
policy.rights: per-recording FSD credits/licenses retained; no raw audio redistributed
policy.wsu_negative: only two explicitly bounded publisher no_drone tail intervals
policy.wsu_positive: publisher alignment + entire 3s airborne telemetry >1ft; presence does not establish audibility
